title: Release ships Claude Code local settings holding an approved command with a password
intent: Approving a command with "don't ask again" stores the command line verbatim in .claude/settings.local.json. A newly shipped copy carrying an inline database password and curl basic-auth credential must be critical; both are digit-free, so file.secret-content's generic patterns deliberately stay quiet. Values are synthetic and non-functional.
